rationale:
Issue #1010 reports that dart_style emits three spaces before the ':' of a multi-element constructor initializer list when the last parameter is a `required` named parameter with a trailing comma. The production hunk in lib/src/source_visitor.dart is exactly at that site: the old code selected padding via `parameters.last.isOptional`, which is false for `required` named parameters, so the wider '  ' padding was written on top of the preceding space() call, yielding three spaces. The fix replaces that test with `isNamed || isOptionalPositional`, which classifies `required int x` as named and selects the single-space padding. Same defect, same code path, no behavior added. The minimized patch (patches/minimized-production.patch) is byte-identical to the production hunk of the original commit and drops the CHANGELOG.md line and the fixture, so it contains no doc, config, refactor, or test-only content; production_files lists only lib/src/source_visitor.dart and commit_stats reports a single production hunk. The trigger is the unchanged upstream fixture test/regression/1000/1010.unit, whose first case reproduces the issue reporter's snippet verbatim (required named param, trailing comma, two asserts, three spaces in input, two in expected output); the remaining two cases cover optional named and optional positional parameters, which the pre-fix code already formatted correctly and which act as guards against over-correction. It is driven by the pre-existing test/formatter_test.dart harness and uses no API introduced by the fix. Machine-generated strict gates pass in both strict_original and strict_post_minimization: build.both_versions, trigger.buggy_differential with reproduced selector test/formatter_test.dart::regression 1010.unit, trigger.fixed_clean, trigger.deterministic (3 fingerprint groups over 3 repetitions), full_suite.buggy_reproduces_only_triggers, and full_suite.fixed_all_green, with no failed_checks. root_cause_id matches the single entry in allowed_root_cause_ids and active_same_project_root_causes is empty, so no duplicate.

Issue #1010 reports that `dart format` emits three spaces before the `:` of a multi-element constructor initializer list when the last parameter is a `required` named parameter with a trailing comma. The production hunk in lib/src/source_visitor.dart is exactly at that site: the buggy code chose padding via `node.parameters.parameters.last.isOptional ? ' ' : '  '`, and a `required` named parameter is not optional, so it fell into the two-space branch and, combined with the preceding space(), produced three spaces. The fix replaces the predicate with `isNamed || isOptionalPositional`, which is the precise condition the issue describes (named or optional-positional trailing parameter). The trigger fixture test/regression/1000/1010.unit is the unchanged upstream fixture from the same single-commit PR #1015 and its first case is a verbatim copy of the issue reproducer (`Foo({required int x,}) : assert(x != 0), assert(x != -1);` expecting two spaces); it exercises only formatter output through the existing .unit harness in test/formatter_test.dart and introduces no dependency on any API added by the fix. The minimized production patch is the production hunk alone: the CHANGELOG.md entry and the fixture from the original commit are excluded, and there is no refactor, rename, feature extension, or config change beyond hoisting the padding value into a local variable required to express the new condition. Strict machine evidence for both original and post-minimization runs passes every gate, including trigger.buggy_differential and trigger.fixed_clean, with reproduced selector test/formatter_test.dart::regression 1010.unit over 3 repetitions and a green fixed full suite. active_same_project_root_causes is empty and dart-lang/dart_style#1010 is the sole entry in allowed_root_cause_ids, so this root cause is not a duplicate.

risks: The single trigger selector aggregates three fixture cases; only the first corresponds to the reported defect, so the other two are regression guards rather than defect reproductions and cannot be failed independently.
